text: Moved machine and aggregate state out of the committed `.yolo-twice/`: `project.json` and each `source.json` cursor now live under `cache/`, each session gets a committed `meta.json`, the attention slider goes to gitignored `local.json`, and live-tail summaries go to `cache/text/`, with the old layout migrated on engine start. While verifying, found that `--bare` in `ClaudeCliSummarizer` skipped the login, so every `claude -p` call failed and fell back to structural text; it now passes `--settings {"disableAllHooks": true}` and titles are cut to one line. Four commits landed (582ef0e, 4073b3f, f46f357, 6245e42) and 50 tests pass, but one `claude -p exited 1` failure after restart is unexplained, and Roland's sessions get `meta.json` only after his engine restarts.
